title: Differentiate each term
text: Differentiate the terms $$2e^{\left(-x\right)}$$ and $$x$$ and $$-1$$ one at a time.

title: Use the chain rule
text: The derivative of $$2e^{\left(-x\right)}$$ is $$-2e^{\left(-x\right)}$$, and the derivative of $$x-1$$ is $$1$$. So $$y'=-2e^{\left(-x\right)}+1$$.
